Until #35812 lands, the refusal holds for that cascade too, so an organization that holds a unit cannot be deleted." PR #35930 (`17ed9e7bfd`, merged 2026-11-20T20:28Z) built it, and the Version Packages release was held for it, so it ships in R1. Replace those two sentences with: "It is built ([#35812](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35812)): once an organization's delete is admitted, because it owns no other record, its cascade removes every `sys_unit` row of that organization, retired ones included, each through the engine's delete under a cascade token that only that removal issues; units no longer count as records that block the delete, and every other delete of a unit, a hook's during that cascade included, is still refused 405 `ERR_UNIT_DELETE_REFUSED`." Code: `packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-planning.ts#removeOrganizationUnits`, `packages/objectql/src/validation/unit-code-membership.ts#refuseOrganizationUnitDelete`. Prerequisite: PR #35903 merged (it is open, waiting for its Tier H approval). If #35903 is still open when this week's PR is cut, the sentence can instead ride #35903 itself; d7-D would then mark this row done.
